title: Cobblemon PBG
description: Cobblemon PBG is a new and friendly Cobblemon Server with loads of features/content and friendly community members.
body:
# Cobblemon PBG · The Cobblemon Server for you.
Play how you want, at your pace, with friends or alone.

## Server Features

* **Complete National Pokédex** — all 1,025 Pokémon across every generation
* **All Gimmicks** — Mega Evolutions, Dynamax, Gigantamax & Terastallization
* **Zenith Region** — custom adventure dimension with lore, towns & themed environments
* **8 NPC Gyms & Royal League** — full gym challenge with unique leaders, teams & storylines
* **Hourly Raids** — scheduled raid battles across 7+ tiers with scaling loot
* **Wild Bosses** — rare boss Pokémon encounters in the wild with tiered rewards
* **Ranked PvP** — competitive ranked battles with rewards
* **Player Economy** 
* **GTS & Wonder Trade** — global Pokémon marketplace and random trading
* **Player Chest Shops** — set up your own automated shop for items and resources
* **Breeding & Daycare** — enhanced breeding system with improved egg mechanics
* **Pokébuilder** — customize your Pokémon's Nature, IVs, EVs, Abilities & more with tokens
* **Leaderboards & Tasks** — daily, weekly & monthly competitions with Pokédollar rewards
* **Pokémon Hunts** — solo and global hunt events with multiple difficulty tiers
* **28-Day Daily Rewards** — escalating login rewards 
* **Crate System** — Galaxy, Plushie & Vote crates with exclusive loot
* **Quests & Bounty Board** — new player quest chain and rotating daily bounties
* **UltraSpace Dimension** — custom ultraspace dimension with 4 biomes and Ultra Beast spawns
* **Catch Combos** — chain catches for boosted shiny rates
* **Pokédex Rewards** — milestone rewards for dex completion progress
* **Land Claiming** — protect your builds with a comprehensive claims system
* **Warps & Fast Travel** — server warps, player warps & home system
* **Resource Worlds** — separate gathering dimensions with regular resets
* **Voice Chat** — in-game proximity voice communication
* **Pokémon Trivia** — minigames for extra rewards
* **Voting Rewards** — vote for the server and earn Vote Points for exclusive items
* **Player Wiki** — comprehensive documentation at wiki.parkballgang.com
* **Strictly Non-P2W** — cosmetics only, no gameplay advantages for sale
